description: The Phase 4 screen move (issue #2373). Moves one tool/architecture/context_map.json group (legacy entries with moveTo and group) into apps/<app>/lib, lib/pages or a context's actions/ and data/ folders: each library with its handwritten and generated parts, directives rewritten across packages, barrel imports in moving files split into direct imports, barrel exports of files leaving lib/, or landing where the barrel may not depend, deleted, tests and golden baselines following their imports, path mentions rewritten, moved files from legacy paths carried in tool/architecture/carried_screens.json (stale carries dropped by catch_arch_stale_carry) and generated outputs regenerated by their generators. Plans with dart_symbol_imports.dart, an analyzer-resolved import graph that sees through barrels and conditional imports; each app reaches its screens through its own router library. --classify labels every legacy file host, consumer, shared or unreached; --plan reports moves and blocking errors (closure, cross-app, layer, context order, dependencies, test support, fixture reads, stale folders); --apply writes one commit and the group's record in tool/architecture/screen_moves/ (one file per group, ordered by its sequence, so parallel moves never edit the same record); --verify accepts only what a move may change; --imports-only replays recorded moves onto other branches; --check keeps lib/ and the shared packages free of app imports and every moveTo valid.
